title: Ce-doped NiCo metal–organic frameworks for electrocatalysis
summary: Investigating how cerium incorporation in NiCo metal–organic frameworks relates to electrocatalytic behaviour, with oxygen and hydrogen evolution as the water-splitting reactions of interest. Supervised by Prof. Dr. Safeer Ahmed at QAU.

title: Electronic structure & adsorption energetics
summary: Using density functional theory workflows in Quantum ESPRESSO to explore catalyst electronic structure and adsorbate interactions. The aim is to connect atomistic modelling with experimental questions about catalytic activity.

title: Rechargeable zinc–air energy systems
summary: Examining the literature on air-electrode activity and degradation in rechargeable zinc–air batteries, including the distinction between oxygen reduction/evolution at the air electrode and zinc-electrode failure mechanisms.

title: Green-synthesized oxides for environmental & sensing applications
summary: Undergraduate projects at the University of the Punjab included green synthesis of calcium oxide nanoparticles for dye degradation and urea sensing, and copper-supported titanium oxide catalysts for methyl orange degradation.
